summary: AMASS app-wide RESKIN visual + regression sanity (frontend only, 390x844 web preview). Core flows verified: onboarding (lowercase DM Serif Display 'find your next place from the sky' + onboarding-next/skip/signin + 4 dots), /login (ink black pill submit) with demo@amass.africa / amass2026, tabs (floating-bottom-nav + tab-index/tab-discover/tab-marketplace/tab-neighbours/tab-profile) rendering as edge-to-edge glass bar with labels, Discover (lowercase serif greeting 'ada', 6 category tiles as soft-grey tiles, 8 featured listing-card-* opening /property/[id], save-* heart toggles, discover-search + discover-notifications), Home map (home-search-input, filter-chip-for-sale/to-rent toggling ink-active, open-filter-sheet opens FilterSheet, map-balance-chip, fab-zoom-in/out/locate, map-legend, M/P balance pills), Market (mkt-tab-brands/fixa/declutter + market-search-bar; Brands view renders retailers; AdModal pops after ~3s and is dismissible via 'Skip' text), Neighbours (serif 'neighbours' title, all 4 nb-quick-* tiles, nb-inbox/nb-ask/nb-report-issue, nb-estate-* card), Profile (ink wallet-card, profile-topup gradient pill, stat-saved, stat-unlocked, theme-toggle switches light↔dark, sign-out-button, all 6 spot-checked menu-* rows present), Wallet (mass-balance + fix-balance serif numerals, wallet-action-buy-mass gradient, wallet-action-subscribe, wallet-action-earn, wallet-daily-bonus, wallet-history, 60 tx-* rows), Settings (segmented theme control works), /register ('create your account' lowercase serif), /forgot-password, /phone?purpose=signin, /notifications, /earn, /buy-tokens, /agent-plans, /fixa — all load without red-screen. Dark mode toggle produces near-black (#111) bg. No PageError/console red screen on any screen. Fonts (Plus Jakarta Sans + DMSerifDisplay) load.

ui_bugs.issue: Review-request spec asked for testIDs 'segment-system/segment-light/segment-dark'; actual implementation uses 'theme-system/theme-light/theme-dark' (SegmentedControl called with testIDPrefix='theme' from settings.tsx). Control itself works. Either align spec or rename prefix.
No stable testID for Skip / Close controls on the sponsored modal (same gap flagged in iteration_54). Only a 'Skip' text node and a close ✕ IconButton are available; automated dismissal is fragile.

issues: On non-owned, locked listings we expected unlock-cta-btn + unlock-dialog. On the one property visited the sticky bar renders 'Manage listing' because demo user is an agent/admin. Could not force an unlocked state in web test to re-verify the dialog's unlock-fee/unlock-balance/unlock-balance-after/unlock-confirm(gradient)/unlock-cancel chain for this iteration; dialog code paths and tokens remain in /app/frontend/src/ui/UnlockDialog.tsx but need manual spot check by main agent.

action_items: Decide canonical name for the Appearance segmented control testID: either rename settings.tsx SegmentedControl testIDPrefix from 'theme' to 'segment' (matches review spec) or update the design spec/docs. Current app ships 'theme-system/light/dark'.
Add testID='ad-skip' / testID='ad-close' on AdModal controls (recurring request from iteration_54) so test agents and accessibility users can dismiss reliably.

Confirm (via manual tap or an alt test user) that UnlockDialog (unlock-dialog + unlock-fee/balance/balance-after + unlock-confirm gradient + unlock-cancel) still renders after reskin. Verified from source that /app/frontend/src/ui/UnlockDialog.tsx remains wired; just not exercised in this run because the demo user resolves to agent/manage-listing on first-row listings.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/marketplace.tsx L718 — the sell-fab correctly hides on 'brands' section and renders ink-black on Declutter / FIXA; selector in test was blocked by AdModal overlay, not a code bug.

/app/frontend/src/theme/tokens.ts — fontFamilies maps 'semibold', 'bold', 'extrabold' all to PlusJakartaSans-500 which matches the spec cap at 500. Any legacy call-site still asking for a heavier face silently resolves to Medium. Safe but worth a one-line note so devs don't try to override.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all 11 flow categories in the review request rendered and were interactive; 2 low-priority testID gaps and 1 unverifiable path (unlock dialog on a non-owned locked listing)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login demo@amass.africa / amass2026 lands on home map tab (/). Onboarding appears for anonymous sessions; onboarding-signin or onboarding-skip link to /login. Appearance segmented control uses testIDPrefix='theme' (NOT 'segment'). AdModal on Market has no stable close testID — use get_by_text('Skip') or wait for auto-close. Demo user is admin+agent so first listings in /api/properties show 'Manage listing' instead of the unlock CTA; iterate through a few property IDs to find one that genuinely requires unlocking before testing unlock-dialog. /api/properties returns 50 listings publicly without auth, but /api/auth/me only works with the SecureStore token (not accessible from pure JS fetch in web preview).
rca_of_issue: N/A — this was a pure visual/regression sanity pass after the theme/component reskin. No functional regressions found.
